description: Explicit online query of a public profile or ONE page of followers/following (one source page, usually 25 people). May consume credits: a first list page needs maxCredits of at least 2 (profile + page), a next page 1. Require user authorization for this target, type and maxCredits. Generate and keep idempotencyKey before the first attempt; reuse it with identical arguments when restoring. Never automatically fetch all pages or increase budget.
name: query_public_account
